Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！我不知道你為什麼這麼痛苦！難道你就這麼軟弱嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
痛苦？我？...Aaahhh... 看起來像嗎...？
是啊...的確如此。
真難受啊...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, Ahrum...?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，阿魯姆...？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
...難道就我一個人在逃避嗎...
反正我已經不配了...huhuhu.
不過，我已經做出了決定。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes?... Yes?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是？...是？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
拿著這個。

scripts.text: - swish. -
- Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿魯姆隨手將一把華麗短劍扔給了恩斯特。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
呃？...這是怎麼回事？...沃爾特家族的華麗短劍？...為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
時機真是完美。連我們的證人都在場！恩斯特，你很清楚我們之間的約定，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What? Promise? Witness?...Ahh... Re-really...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
什麼？約定？證人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, really. Now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沒錯，就是現在。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
胡說！你以為我會對你下殺手嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
蠢貨！當國王就得殺伐果斷。
我已經沒資格當國王了。
與其腐敗下去，這樣苟活，倒不如死在你手裡...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...不，你可以像以前一樣活下去！就當什麼都沒發生過。你只需要回到從前的樣子。哥哥，讓我幫幫你。告訴我你隱藏的一切...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這太愚蠢了！你還能說自己有王者風範嗎？現在才來同情我？你應該是個有理智的人！如果不是，你就沒有資格成為國王候選人！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bu...but!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...但是！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這樣來回爭論毫無意義！我別無選擇。如果你堅持己見，而不是像個有理智的人那樣行事，那麼這樣的人就不配當國王。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ghh?! Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
嘎？！哥哥？！

scripts.text: (dagger thrusting sound)
scripts.translation: (短劍刺入的聲音)

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bbb... Brother?... You... told me 
you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed
by me?... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？...你...你說過要殺我...你只是想讓我殺你嗎？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal self-defense, killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
Huhu... 才不是。
我就是想殺了你...僅此而已...
幹得好，恩斯特...殺死惡徒，算是合法自衛...對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...現在還不晚！如果你去找醫務兵，還能救回來！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我還能怎麼活下來...或者怎麼復活...我不需要活著。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother....How...how could you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...你...你怎麼能這樣？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
再見，我的兄弟...成為國王，改變這個國家。
你...你一定能做到...guk...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥...哥哥...為什麼...為什麼...你的表情看起來那麼滿足？怎麼...？哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
Huhu...你不必知道。
不過，你遵守了約定...你應該成為國王...
可你若迷失方向、誤入歧途，我隨時會從地獄回來殺你！！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我...我不知道！我不知道發生了什麼！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你不必知道...你只要記得，我為此做出了犧牲。
為了不讓我的死白費，你一定要做個好國王。
這是我的信念...就是這樣...guk..!
別忘了我的話...gukkuk.

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Idiot... Moron...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
笨蛋...蠢貨...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊...評估員，你知道該怎麼做嗎？謹言慎行。關於你看到的、聽到的...你絕不能把你的經歷全部告訴檢查員。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特在這裡殺死了那個橫行霸道的惡棍...我沒有機會...他展現了果斷的行動，這足以讓他擁有成為國王的資格...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
要是你沒處理好這件事，我就白死了...kuk...
明白嗎？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
scripts.translation: ...好，我會遵從你的意願...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Okay, I will follow your will. Don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好的，我會遵從你的意願。別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沉默...就是同意...這意味著...我的提議...成功了...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
現在...我可以...安息了...謝...謝你們...兩個...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
那麼，永遠...再見...抱歉...現在沒法去釣魚了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B...bro?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B... bro, brother!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥，哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brotherrrrrrrr!!!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！！！

scripts.text:
[Prince]
You are not allowed to be here.
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你不能待在這裡。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Get out of my way.
I don't want to confront you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
讓開。
我不想和你衝突。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Are you the new adventurer appraiser? I am Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family. You can call me Prince Ahrum, for short, at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是新的冒險者評估員嗎？我是沃爾特家族的艾根·阿魯姆。你可以叫我阿魯姆王子，這樣比較方便。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I hope you ask me short and simple questions. Long questions don't always mean special and good answers.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
問題儘量簡短明瞭吧。
問得冗長，也不見得能得到什麼獨到、精彩的回答。

scripts.text: -What shall I ask...-
scripts.translation: -我該問什麼...-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd like to ask about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想問問關於...

scripts.text: Your background story...
scripts.translation: 你的身世背景...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你對國家的看法...

scripts.text: Your hobbies or interests...
scripts.translation: 你的興趣愛好...

scripts.text: Never mind, I'll come by later.
scripts.translation: 算了，我改天再來

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You aren't just trying to dissolve your curiosity about the king's family, are you?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你該不會只是想滿足對王室的好奇心吧？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
From my childhood, I liked to experience many things and learn them. As a result, I should bear interference from my family. To them, I was not a decent noble family member.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
從小我就喜歡體驗各種事物並從中學習。結果就是，我不得不忍受家族的干涉。在他們眼裡，我並不是一個得體的貴族。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But I am not sensitive to that, and I think a good king should neglect those trifles.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
不過，我不在意。
我覺得，想做個好國王，就不該把這些瑣事放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Others can say that my behavior makes them embarrased, but if something ends well, they are all satisfied in the end. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
別人可能會說我的行為讓他們感到尷尬，但如果事情最終圓滿，他們終究會滿意的。我這樣想錯了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Although I've skipped some lessons in life, I can back up missing lessons easily. Who cares who can swear to me as King! This is how I am.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
雖然人生有些課我沒好好上過，但要補上也不難。
管別人怎麼罵我，我照樣能當國王！
我就是這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern nags me a lot
about this, but I don't make an issue in any case. Such a fastidious jerk.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特經常為此嘮叨我，但我無論如何都不會在意。真是個挑剔的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Like I said, I've been growing up with his scolds. I feel his words were harsher than others who shut their mouth after I accomplish something.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
就像我說的，我從小就是在他的斥責中長大的。我覺得他的話比那些在我做成事後就閉嘴的人更嚴厲。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
He always says that results cannot be everything that matter.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
他總是說，結果不能代表一切。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Before everything else, it is luck and glory for me, that I could be born in Walter, a distinguished noble family.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
首先，對我來說，最大的幸運和榮耀就是出生在沃爾特這個顯赫的貴族家庭。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Of course, my abilities
are underestimated because of my background. In other respects, I feel sad about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
當然，別人也因為我的出身而低估我的能力。
想到這一點，又覺得有些遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the coming age, people will talk about me as Eigen Ahrum from the Walter family, not Eigen Ahrum of Walter.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
將來，人們提起我時，會說“出身沃爾特的艾根·阿魯姆”，而不是“沃爾特家的艾根·阿魯姆”。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The Walter family itself has high distinction and fame, but I will make the name shine further, and others will be proud of me.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沃爾特家族本身享有崇高的地位和名聲，但我會讓這個名字更加閃耀，讓其他人以我為榮。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The nation I organize
will not be harmonious
with pastel color of fairy
tales.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我心目中的國家，不會是童話裡那種一團和氣、色彩柔和的國度。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
For sure, losers and depressed people have their own faults, like lesser challenges for their lives.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
失敗者和失意的人，當然也有自己的問題，比如不願主動挑戰生活。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I have some belief in the benefit of unlimited competition. Frankly, I don't like this king election system from noble families.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我相信，充分競爭能帶來好處。
坦白說，我並不喜歡這種只從貴族家族中選國王的制度。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Although all these
status system fade away
I will be the king, with my sole capability and aptitude! Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
就算這一切身份制度都消失了，我也能憑自己的能力和才幹，當上國王！
Hahaha.

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I know quite well about
other king cadidates, personally.
But I can't find one distinguished person who can lead this kingdom well.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我對其他國王候選人相當瞭解。但我找不到一個能很好地領導這個王國的傑出人物。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I'm not saying they aren't outstanding, but considering the current situation of Rune-Midgarts, they don't seem to be astonishing leaders.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我不是說他們不優秀，但考慮到盧恩·米德加茲的現狀，他們似乎並不是令人驚歎的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
For this reason, I assure you that no candidate is fit for the position among them. If I have to pick someone who can be a match for me, I can say that one is Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
正因如此，我向你保證，他們之中沒有一個人適合這個職位。如果非要選一個能與我匹敵的人，我會說是恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
He has a soft personality and thinks too long about things, but I admit many merits to him. I can say he is a fairly high-standard candidate.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
他性子軟，遇事考慮得太久，不過我承認，他有很多長處。
可以說，他是個相當出色的候選人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Hmm, I was too talkative.
I apologize for my redundant words, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
嗯，說得太多了。
抱歉，講了一堆多餘的話，hahaha.

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I enjoy activities.
I can't stand passive games,
like card and board games
I think those games are
quite fit for the scholar type people.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我喜歡活動身體。
紙牌、棋類這些靜坐的遊戲，我可受不了。
那倒適合學究氣重的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
My brother Ern can stick to something for a long time, like books or study.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我的兄弟恩斯特能長時間專注於某件事，比如讀書或學習。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Once I become king,
I won't handle documents
while sitting all day.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
一旦我成為國王，我不會整天坐著處理檔案。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's very hard for me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
那對我來說非常困難。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Okay...
as you please.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
好吧...
隨你便。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...brother, if you want...
...Ah, please leave here.
I don't want to see anyone.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥，如果你想...
...啊，請離開這裡。
我不想見任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother Ahrum...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...阿魯姆哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Did you meet my brother Ahrum? He is a great man. Really.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
你見過我阿魯姆哥哥嗎？他是個很棒的人。真的。

scripts.text: He tries to deal with things too tough that sometimes makes things into a problem. But even at those moments, he is willing to listen to my words; so we seldom seem to be in serious trouble.
scripts.translation:
他有時處事太強硬，反而會惹出問題。
不過就算在那種時候，他也願意聽我的勸，所以我們很少真鬧出大亂子。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
That can only be that way, because we two have been so close to each other.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
之所以能這樣，是因為我們兄弟倆一直關係很親密。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother Ahrum has been blaming me for that, I think unnecessarily too long. But he listens to me and acts as I advise.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我覺得阿魯姆哥哥為此責備我有些沒必要，而且責備得太久了。但他聽我的話，並按照我的建議行事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Isn't he a great person?
He is a trustworthy and instructive person.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
他不是一個偉大的人嗎？
他是一個值得信賴且能給人啟發的人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah, now I am going to have a plan with Bro Ahrum
If you don't have a important issue with me, I shall go.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊，我和阿魯姆哥哥還有約。
如果沒有要緊事，我就先走了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah, I heard person from Walter came in here. Have you seen him?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊，我聽說沃爾特的人來了這裡。你見過他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
It seems that even brother Ahrum hasn't met with him. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
看來連阿魯姆哥哥都還沒見到他。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Welcome, judge.
We meet quite open
Why don't you slow down your work?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
歡迎，評估員。
我們見面還真頻繁呢。
要不要放慢些腳步，歇一歇？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Hmm...I don't have any more words to say. Moreover, Ahrum seems to be strange these days. I worry about that. I hope it's not a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯...我沒什麼話要說了。而且，阿魯姆最近似乎有些不對勁。我很擔心。希望不是什麼大事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ahrum is getting weird.
It's not a normal change, but a real corruption. I feel uneasy about it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
阿魯姆變得很奇怪。
這不是普通的改變，而是真正的墮落。這讓我感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
This isn't happening.
I believe Ahrum will be restored as he was. However, I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
這不可能發生。
我相信阿魯姆會恢復原樣。但我心裡很不好受。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ah...
Brother Ahrum...
Eigen Ahrum...yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
啊...
阿魯姆哥哥...
艾根·阿魯姆...是的，大人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Please leave here. I don't want to see anyone.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
請離開這裡。我不想見任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Welcome, appraiser.
Thank you for your hard work. It's hard to judge others, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
歡迎，評估員。
感謝您的辛勤工作。評判他人是很困難的事，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
You are not a adventurer judge
I think you shouldn't be here.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你不是冒險者評估員。
我覺得你不應該在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hi
you are the judege.
I am Ernst, prince of Geoborg.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，你是評估員。
我是恩斯特，吉爾伯格的王子。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I think it's hard work that judges people's talents. I will do my best to help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我認為評判他人的才能是一項艱鉅的工作。我會盡力協助您。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Well, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He seems to have a polite personality as a candidate for King)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（作為國王候選人，他似乎是個彬彬有禮的人）

scripts.text: -Well, what questions.-
scripts.translation: -那麼，問些什麼呢？-

scripts.text: backgroud first.
scripts.translation: 先問問背景

scripts.text: I want to know your spirit of nationalism.
scripts.translation: 我想了解你的治國理念

scripts.text: Your habbit and tastes.
scripts.translation: 你的習慣和喜好

scripts.text: I will be back.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Since I was young, I have grown up with a royal education. I haven't quarreled with others seriously, but I was not very polite either.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我從小接受王室教育。雖然我沒有和別人發生過嚴重的爭吵，但我也並不十分禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
People thought that I was timid, but that's because I didn't want to be shun from others.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
人們覺得我膽小，其實是因為我不想被他人疏遠。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Of course, we got an exception... Eigen.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
當然，我們也有例外...艾根。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eigen Ahrum can be the exception. He is not polite, but he makes sense from others with exact confirmation.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
艾根·阿魯姆是個例外。他雖然不講究禮節，卻總能用確鑿的結果讓人信服。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I think that is a great ability, and I should learn it. But, it is not only about results, but also a courtesy matter. We should keep something that we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我認為這是一種很棒的能力，我也應該學習。但這不僅僅是結果的問題，更是禮儀的問題。有些規矩我們必須遵守。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
For me, the process was more important than the result. Now, I take them as equal virtue. I didn't take results significantly. Ahrum taught me, who used to consider the result as nothing.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
對我來說，過程比結果更重要。現在，我將兩者視為同等的美德。我以前並不看重結果，是阿魯姆教會了我這一點。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
The spirit of nationalism when I become King?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我成為國王后的治國理念？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
You might believe the power of a king is unlimited, but as one man, it has a limitation.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
你或許覺得國王無所不能，但終究只是一個人，能力總有極限。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Both normal public and prominent people take charge of the society that gathers that wisdom is easier than doing things on your own.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
無論是普通百姓還是顯貴，匯聚眾人的智慧來治理社會，比獨自行事要容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Ahrum will help me to supplement any shortcomings. Not only Ahrum, but all ministers and cabinet members; and the public is my master.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
阿魯姆會幫我彌補不足。
不光是他，還有各位大臣、內閣成員，乃至百姓，都是我的老師。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
It is my fortune that I got many masters beside Ahrum. It is also good for my country.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
除了阿魯姆，我還有這麼多老師，實在幸運。
這對國家也是好事。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
II don't have special habits. I am just willing to learn and read books.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我沒有特別的習慣。我只是喜歡學習和讀書。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
And I also love to talk with Ahrum. Ahrum is clever enough to generate new ideas that I can follow.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我也喜歡和阿魯姆聊天。
他聰明，常有新想法，能給我不少啟發。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Well, to tell the truth, going fishing with Ahrum is better. Although, we are too busy to go fishing because of all these kingdom issues.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不過，說實話，還是和阿魯姆一起釣魚更好。
可惜王國事務太多，忙得抽不出時間。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We promised to go fishing after the taking of the throne... Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我們約定在登基後去釣魚...讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Hmm...is that enough?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
嗯...這樣夠了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes, then, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是的，那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Aged Noble]
You don't have to worry.
Once my Eigen Ahrum is chosen to be king, the Richard family will be a second magnate.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的貴族]
你不必擔心。
一旦我的艾根·阿魯姆被選為國王，理查德家族將成為第二大家族。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Hehe, Ahrum is the most favorable and influential candidate already. You would be so amazing were you to fulfill this.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
Hehe，阿魯姆已經是最有希望、最有影響力的候選人了。
要是真能促成此事，您可就了不起了。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Although Ahrum is a strong candidate, the prince of Gaebolg has a high reputation for his virtues too. For sure, it is better to confirm things.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
雖然阿魯姆是強有力的候選人，但吉爾伯格的王子也因美德而享有盛譽。當然，最好還是確認一下。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
So, are you on the project of Prince Ernst's poisoning?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
那麼，你是參與了對恩斯特王子下毒的計劃嗎？

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Of course. Even an autopsy will not find it. ... You don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
當然。即使是屍檢也查不出來...你不必擔心。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Ahrum will be elected, once the termination of prince Ernst happens, and then...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
一旦恩斯特王子“去世”，阿魯姆就會被選為國王，然後...

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
both family will lead this country, huhuhu.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
到時，這個國家就由我們兩家說了算，huhuhu.

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
You must know what Walter and Gaebolg did. Both families stayed on top of the country.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
你應該知道沃爾特和吉爾伯格做過什麼。這兩個家族一直凌駕於國家之上。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
The weakest one of the seven families, Gaebolg Family, took power by uniting with Schmidt and Walter.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
七大家族中最弱的吉爾伯格家族，通過與施密特和沃爾特結盟奪取了權力。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Yes, that's why the union of Walter and Gaebolg is perfect. Moreover, Ahrum and Ernst... It's obviously the second coming of Schmidt and Heinrich.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
沒錯，沃爾特和吉爾伯格的聯盟可謂天衣無縫。
何況阿魯姆和恩斯特...簡直就是當年施密特和海因裡希的重演。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
That's why the Walter family and the Gaebolg Family can't exist together. Their co-existence will bring destruction as it has done in the past.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
所以沃爾特家族和吉爾伯格家族無法共存。它們的共存將帶來毀滅，就像過去發生過的那樣。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Thanks for that. It's good to go. All the people who know of the past will deny to be in league with Ahrum or Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
正因為這樣，我們才好辦事。
知道那段往事的人，都不會願意與阿魯姆或恩斯特結盟。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Anyway, we got a little bit more time. Keep the secret thoroughly; not to tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
總之，我們多了一點時間。徹底保守秘密；不要告訴任何人。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Yes. For the glory of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
是的。為了盧恩·米德加茲的榮耀。

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
All the glory for Rune-Midgarts...
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
所有的榮耀都歸於盧恩·米德加茲...
嗯？

scripts.text:
[A man of Walter Family]
Quiet... Someone comes.
Ok... take care.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的男子]
安靜...有人來了。
好的...保重。

scripts.text:
[A man of Riehart Family]
Never mind...
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
別在意...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Walter is the name of Ahrum.
Richard is the name of Poe.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（沃爾特是阿魯姆的家族。
理查德是坡的家族。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Is this the conspiracy of two families? What the hell..)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(這是兩個家族的陰謀嗎？該死...)

scripts.text:
[Young Noble Walter]
Step aside.
How dare you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[年輕貴族 沃爾特]
讓開。
你竟敢和他說話。

scripts.text:
[Aged Noble Richard]
Hmm-hmm.
What an indecorous person!
scripts.translation:
[年邁貴族 理查德]
嗯哼。
多麼無禮的人！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I told you that I don't want to be king, and I don't have any intention to change my mind!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我說過我不想當國王，而且我絕不改變主意！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother! I don't know why you are suffering so much! Are you this weak a creature?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！我不知道你為什麼這麼痛苦！難道你就這麼軟弱嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
痛苦？我？...Aaahhh... 看起來像嗎...？
是啊...的確如此。
真難受啊...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, Ahrum...?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，阿魯姆...？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Is it only me that gets away... Anyhow, I am a disqualified person ... huhuhu. But, I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
...難道就我一個人在逃避嗎...
反正我已經不配了...huhuhu.
不過，我已經做出了決定。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ernst.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Yes?... Yes?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
是？...是？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
拿著這個。

scripts.text: - swish. -
- Ahrum casually throws a Bazerald to Ernst.-
scripts.translation: - 阿魯姆隨手將一把華麗短劍扔給了恩斯特。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
呃？...這是怎麼回事？...沃爾特家族的華麗短劍？...為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
時機真是完美。連我們的證人都在場！恩斯特，你很清楚我們之間的約定，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What? Promise? Witness?...Ahh... Re-really...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
什麼？約定？證人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, really. Now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沒錯，就是現在。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
胡說！你以為我會對你下殺手嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
蠢貨！當國王就得殺伐果斷。
我已經沒資格當國王了。
與其腐敗下去，這樣苟活，倒不如死在你手裡...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...不，你可以像以前一樣活下去！就當什麼都沒發生過。你只需要回到從前的樣子。哥哥，讓我幫幫你。告訴我你隱藏的一切...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這太愚蠢了！你還能說自己有王者風範嗎？現在才來同情我？你應該是個有理智的人！如果不是，你就沒有資格成為國王候選人！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bu...but!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...但是！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這樣來回爭論毫無意義！我別無選擇。如果你堅持己見，而不是像個有理智的人那樣行事，那麼這樣的人就不配當國王。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ghh?! Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
嘎？！哥哥？！

scripts.text: (dagger thrusting sound)
scripts.translation: (短劍刺入的聲音)

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Whoever be the king,
let's make Rune-Midgarts...
the best country in the world, by helping each other.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
無論誰當國王，我們都要互相扶持，把盧恩·米德加茲...建成世界上最好的國家。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We can make it.
No, we shall make it. For Brother and I together, we shall make it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我們能做到的。
不，我們一定能做到。我和哥哥一起，一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But... If I am to reign, or help you; and if I am corrupted... you kill me... by your hand.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
但是...如果我掌權，或者輔佐你；如果我變得腐敗...你就殺了我...用你的雙手。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
反之亦然，我也會殺了你，你明白嗎？
所以永遠不要偏離正道，也永遠不要忘記你的決心。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, you think about hell.
It will never happen, so...
Don't talk that way.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，你想得也太可怕了。
那種事永遠不會發生的，所以...別那樣說。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It is an assumption.
Don't take it too seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
那只是一個假設。
別太當真。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Alright, alright. Don't
take it the wrong way.
I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
好的，好的。別誤會。
我一直為了哥哥和王國在行動，以後也會一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ah, the appraiser has come.
How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊，評估員來了。
你怎麼突然出現？我和恩斯特正在談話。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
怎麼了，哥哥？我們沒在說壞事。
我們只是在堅定我們的決心。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You came here in good timing.
We've just decided to kill
the other... if one of us is
corrupt.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你來得正好。
我們剛剛約定，要是有一人變得腐敗，就由另一人殺了他。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
無論如何，請見證這個約定。
你不能拒絕。因為從某些方面來說，這對你的工作很有利，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。
我們的評估員必須有自己的立場和意見。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你這性子，還是太軟弱了。
我又沒強迫他做什麼難事！
管他呢，沉默就當答應了！
提議通過，咱們的約定也就成立了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
Haah...haha... 評估員，冒犯了你，實在抱歉。
不過，這種約定根本不可能有兌現的一天，所以別太當真...
你也知道，除非太陽打西邊出來...~

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
現在，讓我回房間了。繼續努力吧，評估員。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bbb... Brother?... You... told me you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed by me??... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？...你...你說過要殺我...你只是想讓我殺你嗎？？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal, self-defense; killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
Huhu... 才不是。
我就是想殺了你...僅此而已...
幹得好，恩斯特...殺死惡徒，算是合法自衛...對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...現在還不晚！如果你去找醫務兵，還能救回來！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我還能怎麼活下來...或者怎麼復活...我不需要活著。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother....How...how could you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...你...你怎麼能這樣？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
再見，我的兄弟...成為國王，改變這個國家。
你...你一定能做到...guk...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥...哥哥...為什麼...為什麼...你的表情看起來那麼滿足？怎麼...？哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
Huhu...你不必知道。
不過，你遵守了約定...你應該成為國王...
可你若迷失方向、誤入歧途，我隨時會從地獄回來殺你！！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我...我不知道！我不知道發生了什麼！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你不必知道...你只要記得，我為此做出了犧牲。
為了不讓我的死白費，你一定要做個好國王。
這是我的信念...就是這樣...guk..!
別忘了我的話...gukkuk.

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Idiot... Moron...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
笨蛋...蠢貨...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊...評估員，你知道該怎麼做嗎？謹言慎行。關於你看到的、聽到的...你絕不能把你的經歷全部告訴檢查員。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特在這裡殺死了那個橫行霸道的惡棍...我沒有機會...他展現了果斷的行動，這足以讓他擁有成為國王的資格...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
要是你沒處理好這件事，我就白死了...kuk...
明白嗎？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
scripts.translation: ...好，我會遵從你的意願...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Okay, I will follow your will. Don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好的，我會遵從你的意願。別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ignorance... is positive... It means... My bid... is successful...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沉默...就是同意...這意味著...我的提議...成功了...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now... I can die... with peace... Thank... you very... much, both... of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
現在...我可以...安息了...謝...謝你們...兩個...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Then, perpetually... Bye... Sorry ... now I can't go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
那麼，永遠...再見...抱歉...現在沒法去釣魚了。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B...bro?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B... bro, brother!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥，哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brotherrrrrrrr!!!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥！！！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Moron. You'll never be a king. All throughout your life... Don't you know it? Such a junk addict!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
蠢貨。你永遠成不了國王。你這一生...難道你不知道嗎？真是個毒癮纏身的廢物！！

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...I am not trying to be, but swear words don't make me feel very good. What's wrong with you all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
...我又沒想當國王，可你這麼罵人，還是讓我很不舒服。
你怎麼突然這樣？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am just fed up with you. Even a jerk like you is a candidate for king? I feel sick and nauseated about this king succession.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我只是受夠你了。連你這種混蛋都有資格競選國王？想到王位繼承這件事我就噁心反胃。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Yeah, it's not that wrong. But I am the representative of the Nerious family. I cannot stand for your insults.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
嗯，你說得也沒錯。但我代表的是內裡烏斯家族。我不能容忍你的侮辱。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Is your family aware of your crazy actions? You are ruining your name, and of your family.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
你的家人知道你這些瘋狂的舉動嗎？你正在毀掉自己的名聲，還有你家族的名聲。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...! Yes... I give a crap. No... My existence too! Kukuku...hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
...！是啊...我丟盡了臉。
不...連我的存在也是如此！
Kukuku...hahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, you and I are both disqualified! Hahahaha!! The freaking addict reveals the truth! Yes, hahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沒錯，你和我都不配！
Hahahaha!! 癮君子倒是說出了真相！
是啊，hahahahahaha!!

scripts.text:
[Erich]
... Crazy jerk. Beat it. I don't want to talk with you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
...瘋了的混蛋。滾開。我不想再和你說話了。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, I am going now. Family shame?!! Hahahaha... What is a family!! Kkkkkk!! Very interesting!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
行，我這就走。
家族之恥？！！Hahahaha...家族算什麼！！Kkkkkk!!
真有意思！

scripts.text: -Ahrum, seems to be out of his mind, as he approaches the door-
scripts.translation: -阿魯姆似乎已經瘋了，他走向門口-

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...Nuts.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
...瘋了。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
What did you say? Ahrum?
Hey! What did you just say to me? Ahrum?!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
你說什麼？阿魯姆？
嘿！你剛才對我說什麼？阿魯姆？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I can say it a zillion times! Urugen, you are not beautiful at all! Not even a bit! In fact, your look is very ugly and obscene!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我可以重複一百萬遍！烏魯根，你一點都不漂亮！一點都不！事實上，你的長相非常醜陋且下流！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
That's very rude! How could a dirty germ like you talk like that to me!
you like germ can talk like that
to me!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
太無禮了！像你這種骯髒的細菌怎麼敢那樣對我說話！
像你這種細菌怎麼敢那樣對我說話！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Dirty? Yes, I am. I am dirty. But it is not a problem of mine. Everything is dirty! I cannot stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
骯髒？是的，我很骯髒。我很髒。但這不是我的問題。一切都是骯髒的！我再也受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Hm! I can agree with your words, the world is obscene, but you cannot bring me down to that level! I cannot forgive your words! Never, ever!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
哼！我同意你的話，世界很下流，但你不能把我拉到那個層次！我絕不能原諒你的話！永遠，永遠都不能！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
What if you can't forgive me? What shall you do? That's good. Are you gonna kill me? Will you kill me? Kill me? Haha? You are being called beautiful only when calling yourself!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
不原諒又怎樣？你能做什麼？
好啊，你要殺了我嗎？會殺我嗎？殺我？Haha?
也只有你自己才會說自己漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Akk! I cannot stand this! Such low behavior and words ...? You are no prince. I don't want to face you anymore! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
啊！我受不了了！如此低俗的行為和言語...？你根本不是王子。我不想再面對你了！滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't have enough quality. You don't have belief to eliminate evil. By will, you are rubbish. I don't want to be with rubbish either! Stay in your world forever and never come out of it!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你沒有足夠的素質。你沒有剷除邪惡的信念。論意志，你就是個廢物。我也不想和廢物待在一起！永遠待在你自己的世界裡，永遠別出來！

scripts.text: -Ahrum strides out of the room, grumbling...-
scripts.translation: -阿魯姆一邊嘟囔著一邊走出房間-

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...You are so low. I misjudged you. You are not of the few that have an artistic view. I totally saw you the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
...你真是低俗。我看錯你了。你並不是少數擁有藝術眼光的人。我完全看走眼了。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Military maniac! Jerk! Do you think power can solve everything? In all situations, do you think people can live peacefully?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
軍事狂！混蛋！
你以為武力能解決一切嗎？
你真以為不管發生什麼，百姓都能安穩過日子？！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You are fully violent now.
By your theory, you are also not eligible for the king's quality!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你現在完全被暴力支配了。
照你的理論，你也不具備國王的素質！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, you talk well. Bah!
I don't have quality!!
But you are worse than me! King candidate?? You are just a war monger!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
是啊，說得真好。呸！
我不夠格！！
可你比我更糟！國王候選人？？
你就是個戰爭販子！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You have come here to offend me? Do you think you can beat me, Eigen Ahrum?!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你來這裡就是為了侮辱我嗎？你以為你能打敗我，艾根·阿魯姆？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Fight? That's so rubbish. I don't care for it. I just came here to shoot what I want to say to you. I don't even feel like fighting with you. I am leaving!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
打架？那太無聊了。我不在乎。我只是來這裡說我想對你說的話。我甚至不想和你打。我要走了！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hold on, coward! Are you fleeing now?! Such a coward! Let's finish our battle!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
站住，膽小鬼！你現在要逃跑嗎？！真是膽小鬼！讓我們結束這場戰鬥吧！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Coward.. that's a very nice word. Yes, I am. I am leaving. Ta-tah! You are worse than a bad coward...like me! Bye-bye war monger!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
膽小鬼...這個詞真不錯。沒錯，我就是。我要走了。拜拜！你比我這種差勁的膽小鬼...還要糟糕！再見，戰爭狂人！

scripts.text: -Ahrum grins with a vague feeling towards an irritated Helmut, and leaves the room.-
scripts.translation: -阿魯姆意味不明地朝惱怒的赫爾穆特咧嘴一笑，離開了房間。-

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
That is... such a villain!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
真是...太卑鄙了！！！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You always care about gambling. But, why don't you care about your surrondings first, eh? Young master of Richard?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你眼裡只有賭博，就不能先看看自己身邊嗎，理查德家的少爺？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Why are you teasing me, now? At least I feel I have dice with higher numbers than you... You don't think so?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
你現在為什麼取笑我？至少我覺得我的骰子點數比你高...你不這麼認為嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Posh! You keep talking about dice. Listen. You can feel that I roll lower numbers of dice than you... But you have already failed before the roll of your dice! Do you know that?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
哼！你一直談論骰子。聽著。你能感覺到我擲出的骰子點數比你低...但你在擲骰子之前就已經失敗了！你知道嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
What are you talking about? I can't get you. I've lost to whom? I don't know why you are talking like that.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
你在說什麼？我聽不懂。我輸給了誰？我不知道你為什麼那樣說。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You can't know it! So what?! If you know, what can you do? You have too much pride over everything. Do you think you can foster a deeply rotten tree, to become a healthy tree?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你當然不知道！就算知道又怎樣？！
你能做什麼？你對一切都太自信了。
你以為能把一棵爛透了的樹，養成一棵好樹嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If you want to say something, you have to say it clearly. Are you announcing a loss and defeat? Is my luck so dreadful, Eigen Ahrum?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果你想說什麼，你就得說清楚。你是在宣佈失敗和戰敗嗎？我的運氣這麼糟糕，艾根·阿魯姆？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, I announce my defeat. But it is not to you. You are a loser like me. Before getting into important business, you are ruined by an environmental element.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沒錯，我認輸了，可不是輸給你。
你跟我一樣，都是輸家。
還沒來得及做正事，就已經毀在自己的處境裡了。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
...What the hell are you talking about? Environment? I totally don't get you. It is never clear.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
...你到底在說什麼？環境？我完全聽不懂。你說的話總是讓人摸不著頭腦。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You'd better not understand it. If you know this, you will lose your health. Don't care for it... for the rest of your life!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你最好永遠別懂。
知道了，只會傷身。
這一輩子，都別管這事！！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ho- hold! Look, Ahrum!
Hold on! Eigen Ahrum! Hey!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
等...等等！阿魯姆！
站住！艾根·阿魯姆！喂！

scripts.text:
-Ahrum totally neglects the
voice calling him and leaves the room, with a lonely countenance.-
scripts.translation: -阿魯姆完全無視了呼喚他的聲音，帶著孤獨的神情離開了房間。-

scripts.text:
[Poe]
What... What. It's not fun.
I totally couldn't get him.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
什...什麼。這不好玩。
我完全沒搞懂他。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Peter, what will you do if your work doesn't mean anything?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
彼得，如果你的工作毫無意義，你會怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
...I don't know what you are talking about, but meaningless things do not exist. I don't think you know about that.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
...我不知道你在說什麼，但不存在毫無意義的事物。我想你並不瞭解這一點。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Buzzzz. You are wrong. There is a thing that is meaningless itself. Clearly speaking, the action becomes meaningless without knowing its meaning...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
Buzzzz. 錯了。
就是有些事毫無意義。
說白了，要是根本不懂其中的意義，做什麼都沒有意義...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Are you trying to explain... clearly? It's getting more complicated. What exactly do you want to say? Let me get it directly.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
你是在試圖...解釋清楚嗎？事情變得越來越複雜了。你到底想說什麼？直接告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
...Whatever I do or do not do, I am just being manipulated by some thing. To make it worse, I hurt others as I am in that some thing only.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
...不管我做什麼，或什麼都不做，都只是在受某種東西擺佈。
更糟的是，光是身在其中，我就已經傷害了別人。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
The worst thing is, I feel I just become timid with knowing and understanding the some thing itself..
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
最可悲的是，越看清那東西的真面目，我反而越膽怯...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But it is the same with you. If you really want to express gratitude towards the girl, you should have visited her in person. You couldn't do it, could you?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
但你也是一樣。如果你真的想向那個女孩表達感激，你應該親自去拜訪她。你做不到，對吧？

閉嘴。

[Ahrum]

scripts.text:

閉嘴！你什麼都不知道，連什麼時候會被人殺掉都不知道！
